cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
The Key Fob shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of vehicle entry and engine start.

The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent loss of passive entry and start functionality for authorized users.

The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of keyless entry and excessive vehicle battery drain.

The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages on the RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access and denial of keyless entry service.

The Vehicle RF Antenna shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against Physical Modification to prevent denial of wireless keyless entry and engine start.

The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized door unlocking and engine starting.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Check / Interface Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Integrity, Confidentiality, and Authenticity of RF Transceiver Firmware and Authentication Data against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, engine start, or leakage of sensitive authentication information.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Integrity Verification / Communication Protocol Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of vehicle entry and engine start for legitimate users.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock and Engine Start Commands on the in-vehicle CAN bus against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors or starting of the engine.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware and Configuration Data against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and engine start.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent denial of unauthorized command execution and loss of auditability.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Test / Log Analysis / Message Authentication Verification

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Firmware, Configuration, and Access Policies against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized disclosure or manipulation of sensitive BCM data.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / Local Storage and Diagnostic Interfaces
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Code and Interface Review

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and BCM -> RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate keyless entry and engine start operations.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware and Restricted HSM API against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry or engine start.

The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized physical access to the vehicle interior.

The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command and Door ECU -> Actuator Signal against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized or unintended unlocking of vehicle doors.

The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability, Authenticity, and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent authorized users from being denied access to or unable to secure the vehicle.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Start Authorization Tokens and Engine Start Commands against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle propulsion.

The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of the Engine Start Command against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle propulsion.

The Start Authorization ECU shall ensure the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized prevention of engine starting.

The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors or starting of the engine.

The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability, Authenticity, and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent authorized users from being unable to unlock doors or start the engine.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, engine start, and compromise of HSM security assurances.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Non-repudiation of Start Authorization Token event logs against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent undetectable unauthorized token generation or suppression of verification failure evidence.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0073: Physical Access to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, engine start, and large-scale key compromise.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Firmware Review

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API against Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of keyless entry and engine start functionality.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements and Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations, key extraction, and subversion of the cryptographic trust model.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Analysis / API Access Control Review

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against Manipulate Communications to prevent spoofing of HSM integrity status and unauthorized disclosure of secure boot or firmware information.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Data Flow Security Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0074: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution to prevent the BCM from accepting falsified attestation and unauthorized firmware execution.

The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized disabling of secure vehicle operations by the BCM.

The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine starting.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Analysis / Fault Injection

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Availability of the internal data flow between CRYPTO_ENG_1 and KEYSTORE_1 against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent denial of keyless entry and engine start functions.

The Crypto Engine shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of the internal data flow between Crypto Engine and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized extraction of cryptographic keys and impersonation of the vehicle or key fob.

The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of cryptographic key material in the data flow between the Crypto Engine and the Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0066: Standard Cryptographic Protocol to prevent unauthorized access, impersonation, and bypass of authentication mechanisms leading to vehicle theft or unauthorized operation.

The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized impersonation of the vehicle or key fob and consequent vehicle theft.

The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized unlocking or denial of locking of the vehicle doors.

The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized access or denial of entry due to actuator sabotage or failure.

The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized engine operation or denial of engine start.

The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of vehicle operation.

The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Software Update Mechanism against ATM-T0021: Disable Software Update to prevent persistent unauthorized control over engine start operations.

The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of LF Proximity Signal processing against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unnecessary BCM wake events and excessive battery drain.
The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of passive keyless entry and start functionality.

The Wireless Communication Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: Wireless Communication Boundary (Vehicle RF Antenna and RF Transceiver)

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and HSM shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Firmware and Start Authorization Tokens against Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine starting.

The Restricted HSM API and HSM Internal Bus shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0055: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Collection to prevent unauthorized extraction of secrets leading to vehicle unlocking, engine start, or key cloning.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Access Control Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry and Start System shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, CAN Lock/Unlock Message, and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being denied vehicle entry or engine start.

The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware and Restricted HSM APIs against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors or engine start without a valid key fob.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware and API Security Review

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The LF Antenna and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of the LF Proximity Signal between ANT_1 and EXT_1 against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized challenge initiation and key fob battery drain.

The Passive Keyless Entry System shall enforce the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of passive keyless entry and start functionality for legitimate users.

The RF Transceiver and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Challenge-Response Nonces against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and engine start.

The RF Transceiver shall ensure the Availability of RF Challenge Message Transmission on data flow DF2 against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of passive entry and engine start authorization for legitimate users.

The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Challenge-Response Nonces and Authentication Data against Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

The Body Control Module and Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Commands and CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized door locking or unlocking.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (CAN Bus: BCM to Door ECU)

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Door ECU shall enforce the Availability of lock/unlock command data flow against CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of access or failure to secure the vehicle.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Test / Fault Injection / Network Traffic Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The BCM and Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of the Start Authorization Token and Engine Start Command against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / CAN Bus (DF5: BCM to Start Authorization ECU)

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The BCM_1 and ECU_START shall enforce the Availability of start authorization messages on data flow DF5 against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of engine start when a legitimate key is authenticated.

The BCM shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Auth Data received from the RF Transceiver against Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized inference of key fob presence and vehicle usage patterns.

The RF Transceiver and Body Control Module shall ensure the Availability of Auth Data messages on data flow RF_1 -> BCM_1 against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of vehicle access or engine start.

The Body Control Module (BCM) and Hardware Security Module (HSM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of cryptographic verification request messages and challenge-response nonces against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine start.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Fuzzing / Message Integrity Verification

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module shall enforce the Availability of cryptographic verification API calls on data flow BCM_1 to HSM_1 against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent denial of unlock or start authorization for legitimate users.

The HSM_1 to BCM_1 communication channel shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine start.

The HSM_1 and BCM_1 shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of authorization tokens and verification results on data flow DF8 against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent denial of legitimate door unlocking and engine start.

The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Commands on data flow DF9 against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized locking or unlocking of vehicle doors.

The Door Lock Control System shall enforce the Availability of actuator command data flow between the Door ECU and Door Lock Actuator against CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent failure to execute legitimate lock or unlock requests.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Fault Injection Test / Network Robustness Analysis

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of the Engine Start Command on data flow DF10 against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

The Start Authorization ECU and Engine ECU shall enforce the Availability of start enable command data flow DF10 against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent denial of engine start and loss of vehicle propulsion.
The BCM and Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Start Authorization Tokens on data flow DF11 against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (CAN bus: BCM to Door ECU)

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of unlock command data flow DF11 against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent authorized users from being unable to unlock vehicle doors via the keyless entry system.

The BCM and Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Start Authorization Tokens and related API data flows against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.
The BCM_1 and ECU_START shall enforce the Availability of Start Authorization Token flows against CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent authorized users from being unable to start the vehicle.

The BCM -> RF Transceiver Control Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of transmit control commands against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized challenge transmissions that could enable unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

The BCM_1 -> RF_1 interface shall enforce the Availability of transmit control commands against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of passive keyless entry and engine start for legitimate users.

The RF Transceiver and Vehicle RF Antenna interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of analog RF waveform data flows DF15 and DF16 against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.
The RF Antenna and Analog RF Links shall enforce the Availability of Wireless Communication Channels against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent loss of keyless entry and engine start functionality.

The LF Receiver and BCM shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the LF Receiver to BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle wake events, denial of legitimate user access, and excessive key fob battery drain.
cybersecurity_goals.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle (LF Receiver to BCM Data Flow)

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The LF Receiver and BCM shall enforce the Availability of LF wake/proximity event detection on data flow DF17 against Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of vehicle unlocking and engine start for legitimate users.

The Keyless Entry and Start System shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or bypassing of security checks.

The system shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent degradation or bypass of security policy enforcement and diagnostics.

The HSM_1 and BCM_1 shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of HSM Attestation / Measurement Report data flow DF18 against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent the BCM from trusting compromised or unauthorized HSM firmware or cryptographic keys, thereby preventing unauthorized vehicle operations and loss of root of trust.
cybersecurity_goals.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Data Flow Integrity Verification

cybersecurity_goals.csg_statement: The HSM-to-BCM Communication Interface shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of HSM Attestation / Measurement Report data against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent undetected execution of unauthorized or compromised HSM firmware.

The HSM_1 and BCM_1 shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of HSM Attestation / Measurement Report data against ATM-T0055: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Collection to prevent unauthorized disclosure of sensitive firmware and attestation information that could facilitate targeted attacks.

The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of HSM Attestation / Measurement Report data flow against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent denial of secure authentication or authorization functions, such as keyless entry and engine start.
